descriptor: Design studio for bold brand work

voice.summary: Primer Studio writes big, short headlines that announce a change. It sounds optimistic and confident, and it always points to the next step.
dos: Use big, short headlines with a clear verb
State the shift, then the offer
Keep body copy to two lines
donts: Do not use cliches like game-changing

taglines: A new era of design starts now
Start with a better first impression
boilerplate: Primer Studio is a design studio creating bold brands, websites and campaigns for companies ready to move first and look ahead.

microcopy.success: Thanks. We will be in touch.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Please try again.

logo.note: An aperture signals a lens and a fresh view, which fits a studio promising a new era.
